aamflight.help.title: ===== AAM Air-to-Air Missile Mod =====
aamflight.help.subtitle: Real-bullet guns, homing missiles, line-of-sight lock-on and a War Thunder style RWR
aamflight.help.cmd_set: /aam <option> <value>  — set the global value (affects all guns)
aamflight.help.cmd_base_set: /aam <option> base set <targets> <value>  — set the held gun's base value
aamflight.help.cmd_base_add: /aam <option> base add <targets> <value>  — add to the base value
aamflight.help.cmd_base_get: /aam <option> base get <targets>  — show the base value
aamflight.help.cmd_base_clear: /aam <option> base clear <targets>  — clear the base value
aamflight.help.cmd_att_add: /aam <option> att add <targets> <id> <value>  — add to an attribute
aamflight.help.cmd_item_clear: /aam <option> clear <targets>  — clear this option on the item
aamflight.help.cmd_save: /aam save / /aam reload  — save or reload the global config
aamflight.help.note_perm: (All commands require permission level 4 and only work on the gun held in hand)
aamflight.help.param_1: lmg_dmg damage / lmg_range range / lmg_pierce pierce / lmg_rps rounds per second
aamflight.help.param_2: lmg_bspeed bullet speed / lmg_spread spread / lmg_pellets pellets per shot
aamflight.help.param_3: lmg_mag magazine / lmg_reload reload ticks / lmg_cost reload score cost
aamflight.help.param_4: lmg_bars charge bars / lmg_lockout burst gap / lmg_kb knockback / lmg_tracer tracer interval
aamflight.help.missile_1: mspeed max speed / mstart launch speed / maccelt accel ticks / mseekdelay seek delay
aamflight.help.missile_2: mturn turn rate / mlead lead / mfuse fuse radius / mpower blast power / mlife lifetime / mseek seek range
aamflight.help.missile_3: mretrack re-track count / mflare countermeasure resistance / mstealth stealth
aamflight.help.bullet_note: Exclusive: att add is rejected when another id exists, use att set instead
